commands.command: node Tools/acceptance/p44/run.cjs formal-dispatch-a node Tools/acceptance/p44/capture.cjs dispatch-a
commands.description: Raw capture under the fixed P4-4 plan; one invocation; Undici HTTP <=60s, standard gh archive <=180s, wrapper watchdog <=60 minutes; complete bounded pages; fixed D1 POST queries use standard gzip negotiation and strictly bounded decoding, preserving wire and decoded originals, with unsafe/incomplete new compressed wire retained privately and publicly identified only by hash/size. Only capture-admitted GET and fixed D1 SELECT POST may retry request() pre-response ECONNRESET once, after an abortable 500ms wait within the same 60s signal; retain each failure and retry reservation. No retry after an HTTP response, during body collection, for other errors, private verification or business writes. Only two planned staging dispatches; never approve/reject by API, publish, register directly, upload/delete objects, migrate, unlock gates or operate devices. Waiting/discovery reads are bounded, not repeated business operations. Uncertain mutations are not retried.
